movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Two sticks are held; one for offense, one for defense. Zulu style includes a shield.
movement_profile.partnering: Combatants alternate between offense and defense.

signature_moves.description: Scoring points by hitting specific body parts.
signature_moves.name: Striking

basic_steps: Holding the defensive stick or shield to protect the body
Advancing with the attacking stick to strike a target area
Alternating between offensive and defensive stances
teaching.formation: Two opposing warriors facing each other, overseen by an induna.
